summary.business_type: B2B SaaS — Trademark Monitoring / Brand Protection
scope_constraints: No competitor-comparison / alternatives / vs content (legal risk)
top_findings: Mobile LCP 4.4s (threshold 2.5s) — render-blocking 165KiB CSS + 291KiB fonts, no critical-CSS split.
/solutions parent returns 404 — crawl dead-end on a linked hub.
Dead FAQPage schema on 3 pages (retired 2026-05-07) + homepage schema split across 4 scripts instead of one @graph.
Thin content (~350 words/page) with no educational resource hub — main non-branded organic gap.
Generic OG descriptions on /about + /contact; incomplete legal identity (company.ts placeholders).
quick_wins: Remove dead FAQPage JSON-LD; consolidate homepage schema into one @graph.
Externalize 28 base64 icons; logo -> WebP; icons -> SVG (~40KiB + smaller HTML).
Organization schema: add legalName/address, encode LinkedIn URL, fix contactType.
summary.data_accuracy_note: seo-geo reported 'no server-rendered schema'. INCORRECT — direct render (render_page.py, is_spa=false, mode=raw) confirmed 4 valid JSON-LD blocks in the server HTML. Schema IS present and server-rendered; recommendations are 'improve', not 'add'.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS + HSTS preload, correct www->apex 301, no long redirect chains
Server-side rendered (not an SPA shell) — confirmed is_spa=false
robots.txt correctly gates the app and explicitly welcomes AI crawlers
Valid sitemap declared; self-referencing canonicals on all pages
Comprehensive security headers (CSP, X-Frame-Options DENY, nosniff, Permissions-Policy)

findings.title: Generic OG description on /contact and /about
findings.description: Both pages inherit the homepage OG description verbatim; link previews show irrelevant copy.
findings.recommendation: Set unique og:description + title per route in meta config.

findings.title: 84KiB of base64-inlined marketplace logos in HTML
findings.description: 28 data-URI PNG icons inflate HTML to ~260KiB before parse; Shopify logo is already externalized correctly.
findings.recommendation: Externalize all 28 icons to /assets (or inline SVG) following the Shopify pattern.

findings.title: /solutions parent returns 404
findings.description: Two child pages with a 404 parent is a crawl dead-end.
findings.recommendation: Add /solutions index page or 301 to a child.

findings.title: No preconnect for external origins
findings.description: Google Fonts + GTM origins have no preconnect hints, adding a round-trip per origin.
findings.recommendation: Add <link rel=preconnect> for fonts.gstatic.com and GTM.

findings.title: /contact title only 16 chars; /about meta desc 167 chars
findings.description: Contact title lacks keyword signal; About description will truncate in SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Contact: 'Book a Demo — HAKKIU Trademark Monitoring'. About: trim to <=155 chars.

findings.title: No IndexNow
findings.description: Cheapest way to push URL updates to Bing/Yandex on deploy.
findings.recommendation: Add IndexNow key + ping on deploy.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: 5-person named team with real LinkedIn profiles + headshots on /about
Technical specificity (perceptual hashing, SHA-256 timestamps, UDRP, edit-distance) signals real expertise
Clearly differentiated product story ('autonomous', 'court-ready evidence')
Interactive brand-exposure calculator adds unique use-case content

findings.title: Very thin word count on every page
findings.description: ~350 words vs the depth needed to rank/be cited.
findings.recommendation: Launch an educational resource hub (how-to guides, evidence checklists) — informational only, no competitor comparisons.

findings.title: Authority rests only on the team page
findings.description: No press, no owned research/data content, no author bylines on content.
findings.recommendation: Publish own-expertise educational content with named author bylines + dates; build a neutral Crunchbase profile. (Customer proof: add your own case studies later, once you have consenting clients.)

findings.title: Incomplete legal identity
findings.description: company.ts entity facts are placeholders; imprint lacks legalName/address/VAT — Trustworthiness gap.
findings.recommendation: Fill real legal entity details on /legal/imprint.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Strong, differentiated homepage title and H1
Named 12+ platforms create concrete entity anchors
Clean semantic heading structure with question-format H3s

findings.title: Head keywords are informational/roundup-intent, not product-intent
findings.description: Generic head terms are hard for a product homepage to win.
findings.recommendation: Target long-tail informational queries with the educational hub; let the homepage own branded + high-intent product queries.

findings.title: Thin internal linking; no content hub to link from
findings.description: Only marketing pages exist; no editorial linking surface.
findings.recommendation: Add the resource hub + an internal link matrix once content exists.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: All blocks are valid JSON-LD, server-rendered (4 blocks on homepage)
Organization has @id, logo w/ dimensions, sameAs, employees, ContactPoint
BreadcrumbList present on all four content pages

findings.title: FAQPage schema is dead markup
findings.description: Google retired FAQ rich results for all sites 2026-05-07; present on 3 pages.
findings.recommendation: Remove FAQPage JSON-LD (keep the visible FAQ content).

findings.title: Homepage schema split across 4 scripts, not one @graph
findings.description: Cross-references (isPartOf #website) cannot resolve across separate documents.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into a single @graph.

findings.title: SoftwareApplication conveys little without an offering node
findings.description: No pricing is disclosed (demo-led), so an Offer with price is not appropriate.
findings.recommendation: Add a Service node (serviceType, provider, areaServed, audience) — describes the offering without any price data.

findings.title: Organization missing legalName/address; contactType 'sales' unsupported; LinkedIn URL not percent-encoded
findings.description: Knowledge-panel + EU imprint quality gaps.
findings.recommendation: Add legalName+address, use contactType 'customer support', encode non-ASCII in URLs.

findings.title: 8 /legal/* pages have no WebPage/BreadcrumbList
findings.description: Missing breadcrumb + freshness signals.
findings.recommendation: Add WebPage + BreadcrumbList to legal pages.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: CLS = 0 (zero layout shift) on mobile and desktop
Desktop LCP 0.9s (fast)

findings.title: Mobile LCP 4.4s (Poor)
findings.description: Render-blocking 165KiB CSS (~1,350ms block) + 291KiB fonts across 9 requests + 650KiB uncompressed main JS.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS + async-load rest; preload only above-fold fonts; code-split JS.

findings.title: Desktop TBT 780ms / non-composited animations
findings.description: landing-nav JS runs 8,993ms; 11 CSS animations run on main thread; forced reflow flagged.
findings.recommendation: Use will-change:transform/GPU-composited animations; lazy-load landing-nav JS.

findings.title: 131KiB unused JavaScript
findings.description: index bundle 51% unused, landing-nav 72% unused.
findings.recommendation: Code-split and tree-shake; defer non-critical chunks.

findings.title: Dashboard-only fonts load on public pages
findings.description: Hanken Grotesk + JetBrains Mono ship on the marketing homepage (~90KiB, 4 requests).
findings.recommendation: Scope those fonts to the app bundle only.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended
llms.txt present (rare for a 2026 brand) — names platforms, personas, offering
Question-format FAQ H3s match AI query patterns; answers open with a direct statement
Schema IS server-rendered (contrary to the GEO specialist's note — verified via raw render)

findings.title: FAQ answers too short for AI citation
findings.description: Answers are 39-62 words; optimal AI-citation range is ~134-167 words.
findings.recommendation: Expand each answer with one concrete example + one process detail + one outcome, keeping the direct answer first.

findings.title: Thin off-site presence
findings.description: No neutral company profile, no press, no author bylines.
findings.recommendation: Build a Crunchbase profile, add author bylines, pursue trade-press mentions — all rules-safe (no comparison/reviews).

findings.title: No long-form content to be cited
findings.description: The site is built to convert, not to be cited.
findings.recommendation: Publish SSR educational answer pages (600-1,000 words) with named author, date, cited sources.

categories.name: Images
what_works: No layout shift from images (CLS 0)
Shopify logo already externalized as an asset

findings.title: Logo + icons not in modern formats
findings.description: hakkiu-lockup.png 26.5KiB (18KiB wasted); 20x20 icons served as full-res PNGs.
findings.recommendation: Convert logo to WebP/AVIF; replace platform icons with inline SVG (~40KiB total savings).

findings.title: No fetchpriority / font unicode-range subsetting
findings.description: LCP image (if any) not prioritized; fonts serve full unicode range.
findings.recommendation: Add fetchpriority=high to LCP image; add unicode-range Latin subsets.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Fix mobile LCP: inline critical CSS, async-load remainder, scope dashboard fonts out of marketing pages
Remove dead FAQPage schema; consolidate homepage schema into one @graph
Add unique OG descriptions/titles to /about and /contact

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Externalize 28 base64 icons; convert logo to WebP; icons to SVG
Code-split landing-nav JS + fix non-composited animations (desktop INP)
Organization schema fixes + add Service node (no price)
Fill real legal entity details (imprint: legalName, address, VAT)
Add WebPage + BreadcrumbList to legal pages; add preconnect for fonts + GTM

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Launch educational resource hub (takedown guides, UDRP evidence, perceptual hashing) — informational only, no competitor comparisons
Expand FAQ answers to ~140 words each for AI citability
Add author bylines + dates; build a neutral Crunchbase profile

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Connect Google Search Console + GA4 (enables field CWV, indexation, traffic data)
Re-run this audit monthly; track CrUX field data once traffic qualifies

excluded_per_direction: Competitor comparison / alternatives / vs pages (legal risk)
Third-party testimonials / G2 / Capterra review listings (pre-customers)
